sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: a non-Copy value is invalidated after being bound to a new owner, so the later use of the old binding is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given cannot also remain in the giver's hands.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because no channel object exists for any sender to meet the receiver.
sketches.resonance: A waiting place without a path to it becomes an endless wait.

sketches.mechanism: Conditional preprocessing with #if 0 removes the enclosed tokens before parsing, so the excluded code does not even need to be syntactically complete.
sketches.resonance: The possibility denied early enough is not judged false; it is never allowed to exist.
